Priya (AE): @Liam @Chen launching a 3-week trial with a security-sensitive fintech. Need to align on data access, redaction approach, success criteria, and a soft pricing cap. Quick sync?

Liam (Solutions): +1. Proposed scope: 1) hosted trial sandbox w/ controlled ingest, 2) customer-provided sample dataset (anonymized ~2k rows), 3) eval prompts + automated metrics. Timeline idea: week0 onboarding, week1 ingest + eval runs, week2 iterate + final readout. Thoughts?

Chen (SE): For connectivity they prefer S3 in their account and a read-only cross-account role. Alternatives: presigned URLs or an SFTP-to-S3 transfer. Note: their subnet disallows outbound internet. If we need a pull model, we'll ask for a VPC peering or an S3 VPC endpoint. Ava, can you confirm network constraints?

Ava (Customer IT): Confirmed: no outbound internet from the subnet. We can create an S3 bucket in our account and grant a role for GetObject only. We prefer we run redaction before any data leaves our environment. We can either: a) run our redaction lambda (preferred) or b) allow Redwood to run a redaction step inside a short-lived sandbox. Which do you prefer?

Chen (SE): We recommend option (a) — client-side redaction in your account. It's quicker for compliance and keeps raw PHI inside your perimeter. For option (a) we need: the IAM role ARN for Redwood, a regex/list of PII fields to redact, and a sample redacted file to validate parsing. Option (b) is possible but requires a Private deployment and an explicit retention SLA.

Priya (AE): Buyer question on cost: will the hosted trial be covered by credits or billed? They asked if we can cap compute spend at $3k for the trial.

Liam (Solutions): We usually cover small trials under partner credits up to $2k. For anything above we can set a soft cap and require approval before exceeding. I'll ask Finance if we can stretch to $3k for this account and set alerts at 80% usage.

Ava (Customer IT): We'll need SOC2/ISO docs and to complete a short security questionnaire. Also need an NDA signed before we share redaction rules and sample data. Timeline: can Redwood turn NDA and evidence docs around in 48h?

Chen (SE): We can provide SOC2 Type II artifacts and our security pack link. We can sign a mutual NDA — Security typically needs ~3 business days to answer a questionnaire if it's not too custom. Who is the contact on your side for questionnaire follow-up?

Ava (Customer IT): Emma Rivera (emma.rivera@customer.com) will own the questionnaire. She'll email the PDF today.

Priya (AE): Proposed success criteria to confirm with the customer:
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 600ms for 512-token prompts
- Quality: named-entity extraction recall >= 92% on the curated eval set
- Robustness: end-to-end pass rate >= 98% (ingest, redaction, inference)
- Cost guardrail: trial compute spend cap at $3k or explicit approval if exceeded
- Data handling: no raw PHI retained unredacted beyond 24 hours in Redwood systems
- Demo: run inference and scoring on 1,000 records with redaction applied and provide results dashboard

Liam (Solutions): For evals we'll run 3 prompt families: extraction, classification, generation. We'll provide an evaluation harness that outputs precision/recall/F1 and sample scripts to reproduce. Suggest 200 labeled examples per family to get stable estimates.

Chen (SE): Quick action list and owners: 
- Ava: share redaction rules + S3 role ARN + allowed source IPs (deadline: Tue COB)
- Priya: send NDA to Emma (today)
- Liam: confirm trial credit cap with Finance (EOD)
- Chen/SE: prepare eval harness, sample ingest manifest, and a sample trust policy (Mon)

Ava (Customer IT): Also need a short checklist for inbound connection (allowlist, role trust policy, sample manifest). Can you provide a minimal trust policy we can paste into our console?

Chen (SE): Yes — sample trust policy and minimal checklist below. You can paste the trust policy and then restrict by bucket resource.

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/RedwoodIngest"},
      "Action": "s3:GetObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::customer-bucket/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Minimal checklist:
- Create S3 bucket in customer account and upload sample redacted file
- Create IAM role with s3:GetObject and trust for Redwood ingest role ARN
- Provide role ARN + bucket name + sample manifest to Chen
- If no internet egress, enable S3 VPC endpoint or provide a peering option
- Share redaction rules (regex/fields) and one sample redacted file

Priya (AE): Aim to start ingest next Wed. If anything blocks escalate to #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

InfraBot: Deployment scheduled: trial-sandbox-2026-07-08 -> dev-sandbox, ETA 48h. :robot_face: (automated)

Ava (Customer IT): Thanks — Emma will send the questionnaire and role details by EOD.

Priya (AE): Thanks all — will follow up with NDA and the kickoff calendar invite.
